business_summary: India's largest bank (assets ~Rs70 lakh cr, ~23% of system deposits and ~1 in 4 of new credit; model estimate): ~Rs45 lakh cr loans (retail, SME, corporate), CASA ~39-40%, 22,000+ branches, YONO digital app, and listed/unlisted subsidiaries including SBI Life (~55%) and SBI Cards (~69%). Government of India owns 55.45% (Sep 2026). Q2 FY27 PAT Rs23,038cr (+14% YoY, screener); stock Rs1,000 = P/E 11.7, P/B ~1.5, ROE 16%, down 7.8% in 3 months despite a strong print, after a data-breach disclosure and NIM/one-off concerns (Moneycontrol, 2026-11-04).

revenue_mix.segment: net interest income (retail, SME, corporate lending)

exposures.mechanism: +3pp credit growth (loan book ~Rs45 lakh cr, model estimate) -> NII +~2.5% at flat margin, plus fee/operating leverage => PAT +3%; persistence 0.6 over the year (P/B 1.5x, ROE 16%) => +1.8, rounded +2. Guidance 14-15% FY27 (Q1 call via search; 'retains 15%' per Q2 headlines) against Q1 growth 18.6% flagged as base-effect.

evidence.note: SBI Q2 FY27 PAT Rs23,038cr (+14% YoY), bank retains ~15% credit growth outlook (NewsDrum/Livemint headlines); shares fell ~5% on the day (Investing.com)

exposures.mechanism: +3pp deposit growth/funding ease: SBI deposit growth target 10-11% lags 14-15% credit growth (SBI Q1 commentary via search), so the gap is funded by CD/borrowings or slower loans. Easier funding cuts marginal cost ~10bp on incremental deposits (NIM +2-3bp) and lets credit growth reach guidance: PAT +1.5% x persistence 0.8 => ~+1.2.

+50bp credit cost on ~Rs45 lakh cr advances = Rs22k cr pre-tax = Rs16.5k cr post-tax vs TTM PAT Rs84.9k cr => PAT -19%; cycle persistence 0.3 (cost normalises within 4-6 quarters), P/B-based equity moves less than earnings => ~-6. GNPA is 1.47% / NNPA 0.38% (Q1 FY27), so starting buffer is strong; shock is a tail scenario.

evidence.note: SBI Q1 FY27 analyst presentation: domestic NIM 3.00%, GNPA 1.47%, NNPA 0.38% (via web search summary; Q2 deck not retrieved)

exposures.mechanism: +1pp delinquencies on unsecured book (personal/Xpress credit ~Rs3 lakh cr, model estimate) => ~Rs3k cr extra provisions pre-tax = ~Rs2.3k cr post-tax = -2.7% PAT, plus subsidiary SBI Cards (68% owned, see company_links) => persistence 0.5 => ~-1.2. SBI Cards credit cost has just fallen to 5.6% from 6.5% (pack headlines), so stress is easing now.

+25bp repo: ~40-45% of loans are EBLR/RLLR-linked and reprice at once while term deposits reprice over 6-12 months => NIM +4-6bp for 2-3 quarters (~Rs3k cr pre-tax => +2.5% PAT) offset by weaker credit demand and AFS MTM (handled under G-sec) => net +0.8, range wide because RBI stance changed to 'calibrated tightening' on 2026-10-07 and later hikes can slow growth.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Hindu/Reuters/CNBC TV18 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +25bp 10y yield: AFS/FVTPL book ~Rs5 lakh cr x modified duration ~2.5 x 25bp = ~Rs3k cr MTM loss pre-tax = ~Rs2.3k cr post-tax = -2.7% of annual PAT; one-off so persistence ~0.5 => -1.4; cushion from investment fluctuation reserve not counted. Pack shows US 10y -0.53/SSU (t -1.2): consistent sign.

+1 tightening step (higher risk weights, ECL provisioning norms, LCR run-off on digital deposits): ~50bp CET1 hit or ~Rs8-10k cr extra provisions => PAT -3 to -5% x persistence 0.6 => ~-2.5. As the largest PSU bank SBI also carries data/cyber supervisory exposure after the Oct 2026 breach.

evidence.note: SBI confirmed exposure of ~3,900 customer records on the dark web; appointed cybersecurity agency (Reuters/The Hindu/Indian Express)

exposures.mechanism: +US$5bn/qtr FPI inflow: SBI is a top-5 Nifty weight, FIIs hold 11.07% (Sep 2026), beta ~0.9 to Nifty (pack). Index-level flows of this size move Nifty ~3-4%; large-cap PSU banks capture ~1.0-1.2x => +4. Not a fundamental channel; decays if flows reverse.
+1pp GDP => nominal credit demand +1.5pp, lower slippages => PAT +3.5% x persistence 0.7 => +2.5.
+Rs1 lakh cr surplus liquidity: eases call-money/CD cost and speeds policy transmission to deposits; SBI is the largest holder of system liquidity so benefit is modest: NIM +1bp => +0.8.
+1pp CPI -> RBI stays hawkish (already 'calibrated tightening'), real incomes and unsecured repayment capacity fall, bond yields +10-15bp => -1.2 combined; no direct empirical test in pack.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Hindu/Reuters/CNBC TV18 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +5 VIX points -> FPI de-risking from India large-cap financials; bank beta ~0.9 to Nifty with Nifty sensitivity ~-1.5 per 5 VIX points (model).
+10% Brent -> CPI +0.2-0.3pp and fiscal pressure -> yields up; direct exposure via oil-company credit is small. Pack elasticity -0.26 per SSU (t -0.7) agrees in sign but is not significant.
+3% USD/INR: foreign branches (~Rs8-10 lakh cr assets, model estimate) translate higher but equity value falls with FPI outflows and imported-inflation/hike risk: net -1.

company_links.mechanism: w = % change in SBIN equity per +1% in SBILIFE equity. SBIN holds ~55.5% (model) of SBI Life, mcap ~Rs1.74 lakh cr (price 1,735 x ~100 cr shares) => stake ~Rs96k cr = ~10% of SBIN mcap Rs9.2 lakh cr; holding-company discount applies.

evidence.note: price 1735.4; stake ownership from model knowledge

company_links.mechanism: w = % change in SBIN equity per +1% in SBICARD equity. SBIN holds ~68-69% (model) of SBI Cards, mcap ~Rs55k cr (price 580.6) => stake ~Rs38k cr = ~4% of SBIN mcap.
